rationale: The sanctioned Uinsure ids do not include mobile. Clients are Expo (React Native) for iOS, Android, and web, which the user already chose. A server is required to hold the Resident gate, matching, chat, and PII (NFR-1, NFR-4, R-1), so A is out. No SEO/SSR need, so not B. Domain logic is matching and moderation, not a heavy .NET estate, so not D. C (TypeScript API plus clients) is the closest sanctioned id. Auth is an Account session token, recorded as hmac-session because Entra is the wrong identity model. Web client can ship as Expo web on Static Web App; API on Container Apps in an EU region. React Context is enough for v1 client state; Tailwind v4; yup on forms. Needs confirmation that Expo-plus-TS-API is accepted as the real stack sitting under id C.
